abilities.text: Creatures you control are every creature type. The same is true for creature spells you control and creature cards you own that aren't on the battlefield.
{3}, {T}: Create a 2/2 blue Shapeshifter creature token with changeling.

notes: Changeling on a created token is expressed as `become everyCreatureType` on the tokens the preceding `token` effect bound - the `token` op has no everyCreatureType flag. The static covers only the battlefield half of its line: the engine has no form for 'creature spells you control and creature cards you own that aren't on the battlefield'.
